score_description: At each daily boundary, causally route on seven-day cross-sectional median return and negative breadth. Outside broad declines, produce the confirmed opposite-funding-crowd joint-margin score. In a broad decline, rank 45% relative trend, 35% inverse downside beta, and 20% inverse drawdown depth, rerank the composite, and produce signed resilience-versus-fragility margin. Add the fixed 2.0 pass offset and capture the one final finite signed long-desirability dict. The exact returned dict drives filtering, ordering, side selection, and capped proportional weights.
